prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated production game sprite for Midlife Survivors. Use the RIGHTMOST WORKSTATION in the attached reference only as a reference image for shape, proportions, camera and palette. Ignore the hero and paper character; do not include them.
Square 1024x1024 PNG. Background solid perfectly flat magenta #FF00FF. One desk centered, complete silhouette, generous equal 128px padding, no other scene. This is a 96x104 logical-pixel game prop: extremely clear chunky square pixel clusters, logical pixels enlarged about 7x with nearest-neighbor; outlines 7-10 source pixels thick. No fine texture or details smaller than one logical pixel.
Same compact workstation in all variants: beige rectangular desktop, teal cubicle back panel, one chunky cream monitor, keyboard, mouse, drawers on right, navy rolling chair tucked under front center. Camera TOP-DOWN THREE-QUARTER, see the top and front, front faces DOWN. Match the rightmost workstation reference's silhouette, orientation and relative size of back wall, tabletop, chair and drawers. Do not change desk geometry or add extra side walls. Keep silhouette rectangular and compact, props contained within the back panel's height and desktop width.
Lighting warm upper LEFT; flat cream highlights and navy lower-right material shadows. NO cast shadow on the background. Strictly flat 2-3 tones per material, limited palette: #171C35 outline, #303750 shadows, #526078 slate, #3E7775 teal, #83A89A sage, #A88B70 brown, #D3B78D khaki, #F2D7A1 cream, #FFF0CF highlight, #874C3B russet, #C45C4B muted red, #EF9347 orange, #BFA8CF lavender.
No people, no characters, no text, no labels, no lettering, no watermarks, no floor, no background texture, no gradients, no blur, no anti-aliasing, no realistic rendering. Warm, funny and affectionate office storytelling through carefully chosen large readable objects.
Variant: TIDY PERFECTIONIST. A precisely aligned keyboard and mouse, one neatly squared small lavender file tray, three equal pastel sticky-note squares lined up on the partition, a small healthy succulent, one modest cream mug on a coaster. Desktop has visible uncluttered warm beige negative space. The humor is almost suspicious organization. Keep accent colors quiet.
